payload.title: docs/analysis-briefs/*.md written by 2 cowork agents, committed by neither
payload.summary: Both news-scout and market-watcher have a documented step that APPENDS to docs/analysis-briefs/{TICKER}.md, and both have a working commit step whose git add pathspec omits that path. The ledger appends therefore never reach git by any designed path.

evidence.observed_strand: DBC/VCB/VNM carried market-watcher 2026-08-25T16:00Z EOD entries uncommitted for 9h30m; BID/VCI/VIC carried news-scout c286 2026-08-26T01:35Z entries uncommitted at agent return
evidence.historical_commits_are_incidental: git log -- docs/analysis-briefs/BID.md shows every prior commit came from an unrelated agent doing a broad git add: unified-agent CHEF publish 4fbd578cb, pm decompose 2ddbe5321, session sweep 644e5872e. No committer names this path deliberately.

payload.defect_class: documented write with no mechanically-wired commit — identical class to FIX-NEWSSCOUT-COMMIT-POLICY-NEVER-MECHANICALLY-WIRED (2026-08-15), which fixed the notebook path only and did not close the ledger path
payload.why_it_persists: Incidental pickup by broad-git-add peers masks it intermittently, so it presents as flaky rather than structural. It re-strands on every cycle where no such peer fires.
payload.remediation_direction: Add docs/analysis-briefs/{TICKER}.md for the tickers this cycle actually touched to BOTH agents' existing commit blocks — both halves of the pathspec (git add -- <paths> && git commit -F - -- <paths>), per commit-boundary SKILL.md RULE 2.5, which both blocks already implement correctly for the notebooks. No new mutex needed; reuse each agent's existing key.
payload.not_yet_verified: Whether unified-agent or any other briefs-writer has the same omission. Only news-scout and market-watcher were checked.
payload.router_action_taken: Recovery commit e6fbe0017 landed the 6 stranded appends (verified append-only, 0 deletions). Recovery only — the flow-doc gap is unfixed and will re-strand next cycle.
